world.title: Zimbabwe minibus carrying church members crashes, killing at least 27
world.summary: A minibus transporting church members collided with a haulage truck in central Zimbabwe, resulting in at least 27 fatalities. The accident occurred near Chivhu, approximately 140 kilometers south of the capital, Harare, around 18:30 GMT on Friday. Police reported that the truck overtook another vehicle before striking the minibus, leading to the tragic incident.

world.title: Nepal floods swept away bank vault with Rs 92.68 lakh, then 29 went after the cash
world.summary: A severe flood in Nepal transported a bank vault containing Rs 92.68 lakh from Rasuwa down the Trishuli River to Dhading. Following the incident, 29 individuals were arrested for allegedly attempting to retrieve the cash. The flood has caused significant damage in the region, prompting concerns over safety and the impact on local communities.

world.title: Risk of lake burst near China-Nepal disaster site wanes
world.summary: The risk of a lake burst near the China-Nepal border has decreased, alleviating concerns about secondary disasters during ongoing rescue operations. Chinese authorities reported that the lake, formed after a glacier collapse, appears to have shrunk. This development comes after a devastating flood struck the area earlier this week, prompting fears of further complications in rescue efforts.

business.title: New Renault Triber Turbo CNG Spied In Pune - ARAI Homologation Before Launch?
business.summary: Renault is preparing to upgrade the Triber with a turbo-petrol engine in September 2026. A test vehicle for the Triber Turbo CNG has been spotted in Pune, suggesting it is undergoing final testing before its official launch. This development indicates Renault's commitment to enhancing the Triber's performance and expanding its powertrain options for consumers.

business.title: Sold house, personal assets, now living on rental income: Zee founder Subhash Chandra reveals his finances
business.summary: Subhash Chandra, founder of Zee and Essel Group, disclosed his financial situation, stating he sold family assets, including a house, to repay loans. He now relies on rental income from a small residential property. Chandra mentioned he has ₹6.5 crore remaining, which he plans to use for creditor repayments as per the National Company Law Tribunal's approved plan.

business.title: FSSAI cracks down on Everest: Hing banned, three masalas found non-compliant
business.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has banned the sale of hing (asafoetida) from Everest Food Products and Laljee Godhoo due to substandard quality. Additionally, three masalas from Everest were found non-compliant with safety standards. The company has been instructed to explain the violations and submit action plans to ensure future compliance with regulations.

technology.title: Nvidia's DLSS 5 leaked early, and modders have already broken it out of its Blackwell cage
technology.summary: Nvidia's DLSS 5, initially set for release this fall with RTX 50 series cards, was unexpectedly leaked early within the game NBA 2K27. The early access build included a 158MB library file, allowing modders to access the technology before its official launch. This leak occurred in a game that was not anticipated for significant graphics updates.

technology.title: Buy a new Galaxy Watch with enhanced trade-in savings, return it if you don't like it
technology.summary: Samsung is offering enhanced trade-in savings for its Galaxy Watch 9 and Ultra 2 in the UK, along with a 100-day return policy. This initiative aims to attract customers by allowing them to try the smartwatches, which assist in fitness tracking and provide insights into sleep, energy levels, and weight management.

technology.title: Google rolls out Gemini AI feature to help readers analyse their e-books
technology.summary: Google has introduced a new AI feature called Expert Intelligence for Google Play Books. This tool enables readers to obtain personalized insights from their purchased e-books. Users can upload eligible e-books to access tailored analyses, enhancing their reading experience. The feature aims to assist readers in better understanding and engaging with the content of their digital books.

sports.title: Confirmed: Barcelona fixture schedule for the 2026/27 UEFA Champions League first round
sports.summary: Barcelona's fixture schedule for the 2026/27 UEFA Champions League has been confirmed. The team will start their campaign at home against Feyenoord. Following this, they will face a crucial away match in Paris, which is scheduled just before the first Clasico of the season. Hansi Flick’s side is preparing for a competitive European season ahead.

sports.title: When the maidans disappear, where does the nation go to play?
sports.summary: Maidans serve as accessible public spaces for sports and recreation, promoting inclusivity regardless of social status. They allow individuals from various backgrounds to engage in physical activities without the barriers of membership fees or class distinctions. As urban development encroaches on these open areas, concerns arise about the future of community sports and the loss of these democratic spaces.

sports.title: ‘He’s spoken to Mikel Arteta’ - Julian Alvarez says no to Arsenal & still has heart set on Barcelona
sports.summary: Julian Alvarez has expressed a preference to join Barcelona over Arsenal, stating there is a low chance he will move to the Premier League. He indicated that his heart is set on Barcelona if he leaves Atletico Madrid. However, Atletico has reportedly closed the door on a transfer to Barcelona, suggesting they would consider a deal with Arsenal instead.

health.title: Knee Pain in Your 30s? Causes Beyond Early Ageing Explained
health.summary: Knee pain in individuals in their 30s may not indicate early ageing. Various factors can contribute, including past injuries, arthritis, inflammation, excess weight, and repetitive stress from activities. Understanding these causes is essential for addressing knee pain effectively. It is important to recognize that joint issues can arise from multiple sources, not solely from the aging process.

health.title: WHO's H5N1 Alert Gains Urgency As India Battles Seasonal Flu Surge
health.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) has urged Asia-Pacific nations, including India, to enhance surveillance for H5N1 avian influenza amid rising seasonal flu cases. This call highlights the importance of preparedness against emerging zoonotic threats. India's current flu surge adds urgency to the WHO's appeal, emphasizing the need for robust health measures to mitigate potential risks associated with H5N1.

science.title: A 324-million-year-old fossil from Texas preserves an early insect with 24 legs and paddle-like limbs on its abdomen, suggesting insects did not leave water for land in one sudden evolutionary jump
science.summary: An international research team has discovered a 324-million-year-old insect fossil in Texas, named Chosha praecursor. This specimen features 24 legs and paddle-like limbs on its abdomen, indicating that the transition of insects from water to land was gradual rather than abrupt. The fossil provides important insights into the evolutionary history of early insects during the Carboniferous period.

science.title: 10 jaw-dropping ESA space images that showcase the incredible beauty of the cosmos
science.summary: The European Space Agency has released a collection of ten stunning space images showcasing the beauty of the cosmos. These images feature glowing nebulas, distant galaxies, and breathtaking stellar landscapes. Each photograph highlights the incredible diversity and wonder of celestial phenomena, offering a glimpse into the vast universe and its remarkable visual splendor captured by advanced space imaging technology.

science.title: Scientists took 232 gravity readings across a Utah mountain and discovered 1.55 million cubic metres of ice hidden beneath loose rock, enough frozen water to fill about 600 Olympic swimming pools
science.summary: Scientists conducted 232 gravity readings on Mount Timpanogos in Utah, revealing 1.55 million cubic meters of ice concealed beneath loose rock. This discovery amounts to enough frozen water to fill approximately 600 Olympic swimming pools. The findings highlight the hidden reservoirs of ice in the Wasatch Range, challenging perceptions of the mountain's surface appearance.

entertainment.title: Kuku Kohli prayer meet: Aruna Irani arrives with family as Rajpal Yadav, Madhoo, Poonam Dhillon and others pay tribute
entertainment.summary: A prayer meet for filmmaker Kuku Kohli took place today at Celebration Sports Club in Andheri West, Mumbai. Kohli, known for directing films like 'Phool Aur Kaante,' passed away on August 25 at Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital. Attendees included Aruna Irani, Rajpal Yadav, Madhoo, and Poonam Dhillon, who gathered to pay their respects to the late filmmaker.

entertainment.title: Kuku Kohli prayer meet: Aruna Irani arrives with family as Rajpal Yadav, Madhoo, Poonam Dhillon and others pay tribute
entertainment.summary: A prayer meet for filmmaker Kuku Kohli took place at Celebration Sports Club in Andheri West, Mumbai. Kohli passed away on August 25 at Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital. Attendees included Aruna Irani, Rajpal Yadav, Madhoo, and Poonam Dhillon, who gathered to pay their respects. Kohli was recognized for directing notable films, contributing significantly to the Indian film industry.

entertainment.title: Akanksha Chamola reveals Gaurav Khanna found her bisexuality ‘very hot’ before marriage: 'Will never cheat my husband'
entertainment.summary: Akanksha Chamola discussed her bisexuality, revealing that her estranged husband Gaurav Khanna found it attractive before their marriage. She emphasized her commitment to him, stating, "I will not cheat on my husband," and expressed frustration over societal acceptance of bisexuality. Chamola affirmed her decision to remain loyal to Khanna, highlighting her dedication to their relationship despite challenges.
